name: CST Activity Config
rules:
SKIPCHECK;
FEEDSTRINGS;

# Driver Percentage Share (Activity → Service Line)
# Calculates what % of the activity should go to each service line based on driver values

['Driver Percentage Share'] = N:
IF( !CST Driver @<> 'Input', CONTINUE,

    IF(
        DB('CST Activity Config',
           !GBL Period, !GBL Version, !CST Activity,
           DB('CST Activity Config', !GBL Period, !GBL Version, !CST Activity, 'Input', 'Input', 'Activity to Service Line Basis'),
           !CST Service Line,
           'Driver Value') = 0,

        0,

        DB('CST Activity Config',
           !GBL Period, !GBL Version, !CST Activity,
           DB('CST Activity Config', !GBL Period, !GBL Version, !CST Activity, 'Input', 'Input', 'Activity to Service Line Basis'),
           !CST Service Line,
           'Driver Value')
        /
        DB('CST Activity Config',
           !GBL Period, !GBL Version, !CST Activity,
           DB('CST Activity Config', !GBL Period, !GBL Version, !CST Activity, 'Input', 'Input', 'Activity to Service Line Basis'),
           'Total Service Lines',
           'Driver Value')
        * 100
    )
);

FEEDERS;

# Feed Apportionment Rate in Stage 3 — Cost Centre not in Activity Config so use Total Cost Centres consolidation.
['CST Driver':'Input','CST Activity Config Measure':'Driver Percentage Share'] =>
  DB('CST Activity to Service Line Apportionment', !GBL Period, !GBL Version,
     !CST Service Line, !CST Activity, 'GBL Cost Centre':'Total Cost Centres', 'Apportionment Rate');

# Feeder for Driver Percentage Share
['Driver Value'] => ['CST Driver':'Input','Driver Percentage Share'];
